comparison.objective: Fill a narrow-necked bottle with beads using an inferred funnel.
comparison.physical_skill: Select and seat a funnel, then pour many loose beads through it.
comparison.success_condition: At least 22 of 24 beads must settle inside the bottle for one second.
comparison.reason: Although both protect many loose bodies from loss, this record tests tool selection and gravity pouring into a container. It does not require translating an assembly across a gap while maintaining a continuous raceway.
